data.description:

data.title: FDA-Driven Zanza Delay Keeps Exelixis Fairly Valued, Supporting Willey’s Hold Rating
data.description:

Stephen Willey has given his Hold rating due to a combination of factors tied to Zanza’s regulatory path and Exelixis’s valuation. The FDA’s request for additional Zanza safety and efficacy data, which prompted a major NDA amendment and pushed the PDUFA date to March 3, 2027, introduces timing uncertainty, even though the core outlook for Zanza’s approval in later-line mCRC remains intact.

Willey’s model already embeds substantial U.S. revenue expectations for Zanza in 2027 and at peak, with a high probability of success, yet assumes no contribution in 4Q26, reflecting near‑term execution risk. Given investor focus on Cabo’s loss of exclusivity and the importance of Zanza in backfilling that revenue, he views the shares as fairly reflecting both the opportunities and the regulatory and tolerability concerns around Zanza’s dosing, leading him to maintain a neutral, Hold stance.
